title: Line sketch: Abstract Vessels in Bloom
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A stylized still life features overlapping ceramic vessels, bowls, and pitchers in bold geometric shapes, surrounded by abstract foliage and flowing plant forms. The composition balances warm terracotta elements against cool background tones, using flat color blocks and subtle line details to suggest depth without realistic shading. Clean edges and scattered decorative dots emphasize a graphic, modern aesthetic (derived from painting #140).
